library(tidyverse)

# Loading data
```{r}
loci_in_GRB <- readRDS(file = file.path(project_dir, processed_dir, "loci_in_GRBs.df.rds"))
```

# Preparing gene sets
Gene sets by phenotypes.
Gwas and GRBs have different associated genes. For each (GWAS, GRB) and per phenotipic trait genes are aggregated.
```{r}
# FIrst try, but NAs messed it up
# phenotype_gene_set <-
#   loci_in_GRB %>%
#   select(MAPPED_TRAIT, GWAS_GENES, GRB_GENES) %>%
#   unique()
# 
# phenotype_gene_set <-
#   phenotype_gene_set %>%
#   group_by(MAPPED_TRAIT) %>%
#   summarise(GWAS_sum = str_c(GWAS_GENES, collapse = ", "),
#             GRB_sum = str_c(GRB_GENES, collapse = ", "))
# 
# gwas_phenotype_gene_set <- select(phenotype_gene_set, MAPPED_TRAIT, GWAS_sum)
# grb_phenotype_gene_set <- select(phenotype_gene_set, MAPPED_TRAIT, GRB_sum)

# GWAS genes set per phenotype
gwas_phenotype_gene_set <-
  loci_in_GRB %>%
  select(MAPPED_TRAIT, GWAS_GENES) %>%
  unique() %>%
  filter(!is.na(GWAS_GENES)) %>% 
  filter((GWAS_GENES != "NA")) %>%
  group_by(MAPPED_TRAIT) %>%
  summarise(GWAS_sum = str_c(GWAS_GENES, collapse = ", "))

# GRB genes set per phenotype
grb_phenotype_gene_set <-
  loci_in_GRB %>%
  select(MAPPED_TRAIT, GRB_GENES) %>%
  unique() %>%
  filter(!is.na(GRB_GENES)) %>% 
  filter((GRB_GENES != "NA")) %>%
  group_by(MAPPED_TRAIT) %>%
  summarise(GRB_sum = str_c(GRB_GENES, collapse = ", "))
```

# Functions for gene set proportions
Functions ProportionOfGenesShared and GeneSetProportionMatrix is tranasfered in utils script


# Running gene set proportions
```{r}
gene_set_proportions_gwas <- GeneSetProportionMatrix(gwas_phenotype_gene_set, exclude_set = 5)
gene_set_proportions_grb <- GeneSetProportionMatrix(grb_phenotype_gene_set, exclude_set = 5)
```

# Ploting

Hierarchical clustering
```{r}
hclust_gwas <- hclust(dist(gene_set_proportions_gwas))
hclust_grb <- hclust(dist(gene_set_proportions_grb))
```


Generating heatmaps for GWAS and GRB
```{r}
# Splitting rows/cols to plot into 14 chunks
chunk_no=14
vec_split_grb <- split((1:dim(gene_set_proportions_grb)[1]), cut(seq_along((1:dim(gene_set_proportions_grb)[1])),chunk_no,labels = FALSE))
vec_split_gwas <- split((1:dim(gene_set_proportions_gwas)[1]), cut(seq_along((1:dim(gene_set_proportions_gwas)[1])),chunk_no,labels = FALSE))

for (i in c(1:chunk_no)){
  data_grb <- gene_set_proportions_grb[hclust_grb$order[vec_split_grb[[i]]], hclust_grb$order[vec_split_grb[[i]]]]
  colnames(data_grb) <- rownames(data_grb)
  pheatmap(data_grb,
         cluster_rows = FALSE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         fontsize = 6,
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         show_colnames = TRUE,
         color = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(n = 7, name="Purples"))(200),
         filename = file.path(project_dir, outputs_dir, paste0("phenotype_plots/heatmap_","grb_",min(vec_split_grb[[i]]),"-", max(vec_split_grb[[i]]),  ".png")))
  data_gwas <- gene_set_proportions_gwas[hclust_gwas$order[vec_split_gwas[[i]]], hclust_gwas$order[vec_split_gwas[[i]]]]
  colnames(data_gwas) <- rownames(data_gwas)
    pheatmap(data_gwas,
         cluster_rows = FALSE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         fontsize = 6,
         color = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(n = 7, name="Purples"))(200),
         filename = file.path(project_dir, outputs_dir, paste0("phenotype_plots/heatmap_","gwas_",min(vec_split_gwas[[i]]),"-", max(vec_split_gwas[[i]]),  ".png")))
  
}
```

Bezveze nesto, gene enrichment na nekim traitovima
```{r}
q1 <- grb_phenotype_gene_set %>% filter(MAPPED_TRAIT == "Abnormal thrombosis") %>% pull(GRB_sum) %>% str_split(pattern = ", ", simplify = TRUE)

gostplot(gost(q1), capped = FALSE)

q2 <- grb_phenotype_gene_set %>% filter(MAPPED_TRAIT == "deep vein thrombosis") %>% pull(GRB_sum) %>% str_split(pattern = ", ", simplify = TRUE)

gostplot(gost(q2), capped = FALSE)
```
